requests.title: 冷色室内
requests.prompt: Original environment concept for a Chinese fantasy winter expedition game base, no characters, no text, no UI, no logos. Landscape 16:9. A sophisticated painterly storybook atmosphere like an illustrated stage set: loose human brush edges, broad opaque gouache masses, restrained nuanced colors, clear large shapes, sparse selectively suggested functional detail, quiet negative space, elegant value grouping. Absolutely avoid realistic woodgrain, rows of brick seams, 3D render or game-model look, sharp digital architectural rendering, low-poly vector shapes, excessive brown tint, miniature diorama, shiny materials, bloom, tiny busy detail. The environment must feel inhabited and useful through a map desk, storage, trading counter and archive, connected as one expedition outpost; not a title wallpaper portrait. Use dramatic but gentle coherent light. Reinterpret our previous NAI outpost concept completely in this new hand-painted storybook direction. Variant A: a wide interior seen at near human eye level from the entrance, a spacious room with a slanted depth, a tall winter window at back casting large cool dusty blue-grey light planes, dark muted pine-green cabinets along left for storage, a quiet trading counter and brass balance to right, a warm parchment map desk slightly left of center with one small amber lantern, bookshelves at far right. Broad pale blue wall and floor brush shapes, charcoal green silhouettes, small warm ochre paper accents. Part of a chair and a hung dark coat foreground imply inhabitants, but room remains uncluttered. More poetic than descriptive; open edges dissolve gently into the painted background. Thin drawn accents only at focal table props, no architectural cutaway.

requests.name: 松动水粉
requests.prompt: Use the attached A ONLY as a composition map: storage at left, a planning desk left of centre, a big rear opening, a modest trading desk at right. Completely repaint the image; do not preserve its rendering, textures or props. New setting is a temporary expedition camp OUTSIDE a winter city, modest timber shelter with plain canvas partitions, portable crates and a few folded bedding rolls, one practical paper street map and lantern on the planning desk, a small trading counter with one canvas bag and balance, one portable archive box. Through the rear opening show distant CITY WALLS and snowy urban outskirts, no mountains. Add a small working FIREPLACE along the rear-right wall. Winter is expressed only by the snow OUTSIDE and the fireplace INSIDE: absolutely no snow on indoor floors/furniture, no icicles, indoor winter decorations or festive ornaments. Remove all banners, flags, badges, crests, geometric emblems, occult symbols and decorative signage. No text, letters, numbers, UI, humans, weapons displays or meaningless props. Believable functional furniture with clear walking space. A landscape 16:9 scene. The final picture is deliberately a TWO-DIMENSIONAL STORYBOOK GOUACHE PAINTING, hand made, NOT realistic environment concept art and NOT 3D. Paint the whole scene with a small number of large opaque irregular brush SHAPES. Use economical broad strokes with softly broken unfinished contour edges and very sparse pencil accents. Furniture volumes have just one light mass and one shadow mass; eliminate all wood grain, brick seams, patterned fabric, scratches and granular tiny detail. The floor is one generous warm grey painted mass with an irregular cool-blue shadow shape, not a tiled grid. Cabinets are simple dark olive rectangles with a few light side planes, not individually rendered drawers. A muted dusty blue-grey exterior, warm chalk-cream canvas and parchment, dark pine-charcoal silhouettes, a tiny earthy orange fireplace glow. Matte pigment, visible BROAD brush edges, expressive loose painterly design, restrained poetic colours. Sophisticated quiet illustrated-book atmosphere, planar and lyrical, with no photographic material shading, no bloom, no brown tint covering the image.

requests.name: 冷灰水粉·未来营地
requests.prompt: Edit the attached original A. Preserve its camera, room depth, furniture anchor positions, rear opening and especially the LARGE EXTREME FOREGROUND CHAIR at the left: its tall back and hanging dark garment fill the left quarter, the near armrest projects diagonally toward the lower middle, a strong close-up foreground silhouette larger than the desk, never shrink it into a chair beside the table. Preserve the foreground/middle/background perspective layering. Replace the setting entirely: a modest postmodern expedition camp on the OUTSKIRTS OF A WINTER CITY, approximately ONE HUNDRED YEARS IN THE FUTURE. Contemporary-to-near-future practical materials: canvas shelter partitions, matte steel beams, concrete base, a few modular composite storage crates at left, a planning work desk in the middle-left with a street map, a compact battery work light and one radio, a plain trading counter at right with two practical supply cases and a compact weighing device. A single simple modern refractory FIREPLACE on the back-right, rectangular metal opening, with restrained warm fire. Through the large rear opening show snow OUTSIDE and a distant near-future urban skyline of concrete/glass buildings and a city boundary, absolutely no castle, medieval city wall, watchtower, mountain landscape or medieval furniture. The inside is dry and snow-free. Remove every flag, banner, crest, heraldic badge, rune and meaningless decorative symbol. No text, UI, logos, figures, festive ornaments, cyberpunk neon or science-fiction greeble. Simple inhabited functional camp, not a manor, palace or ancient shop. Completely change the rendering to a hand-painted TWO-DIMENSIONAL painterly anime storybook environment. Low detail, broad economical OPAQUE gouache colour masses, irregular loose broken edges, sparse dry-brush accents, large clear hard-edged light/shadow groups, sophisticated muted grey-blue and neutral charcoal-green with small warm parchment and fireplace accents. Treat chairs, desk, crates and frames as a handful of readable planes; no woodgrain, brick joints, mottled tiny surface scratches or photoreal materials. Floor is one broad quiet grey painted plane. The garment and foreground chair use strongly simplified dark masses. A restrained retrospective illustrated-book atmosphere expressed with FUTURE utilitarian design. No 3D render, glossy sci-fi, realistic concept-art finish or plastic cartoon look.

requests.name: 清透蓝灰·营地
requests.prompt: Create a NEW original commercial anime mobile-game background. Reference image 1 is only our accepted CAMERA COMPOSITION: a LARGE close-up chair on the far left foreground, its near armrest jutting diagonally across the lower-left towards centre, strong near/middle/far depth, rear opening and a usable work area. Keep that foreground chair dramatic and large. Reference image 2 is the strong STYLE reference: clear anime contours and coherent refined colour planes, controlled modern environment rendering, bright clean value separation, sparse intentional shading and polished shapes. Do not copy ANY people, plants, summer resort objects, logos or content of reference 2. Do not preserve the muddy oil-paint texture or clutter of reference 1. Scene is a modest POSTMODERN encampment outside a CITY approximately 100 YEARS IN THE FUTURE, in WINTER. The shelter uses plain off-white weatherproof panels/canvas with matte steel frames; functional, temporary, not a castle or manor. Reorganise the room from scratch into JUST FOUR calm groups: (1) the oversized near foreground adjustable dark-grey chair and one plain dark garment, (2) ONE uncluttered modern planning desk in the middle, holding ONLY a clear paper street map and ONE handheld radio or compact terminal, (3) ONE storage group of two closed modular equipment cases near the back wall, (4) a small simple rectangular modern fireplace at the rear-right with restrained fire. No long shelves, rows of cupboards, decorative books, mugs, bottles, trophies, banners, flags, crests, emblems, murals, occult marks, patterned rugs or random objects. Leave substantial clear floor and wall areas between these groups. Use coherent contemporary furniture silhouettes, quiet clean surfaces and matte materials, no neon or intricate sci-fi machinery. Through the rear opening show snow OUTSIDE and a near-future city skyline/urban boundary in the distance, no mountains, castle towers or ancient stone walls. NO indoor snow, icicles or festive decorations: winter only outside and at the fireplace. No people, text, UI, symbols or logos. Landscape 16:9, entire foreground chair not cropped into irrelevance. Painterly anime illustration finish with clear contour, simplified internal colour/light planes, no photorealism, no 3D render, no granular oil paint, no pervasive sepia or dirty brown surfaces. Colour direction A5: softly bright pearl-grey shelter walls, steel blue shaded floor, dark blue-charcoal near chair silhouette; snowy window a luminous pale-blue large shape, planning desk in cool grey, small gentle amber fireplace accent. High-end clean modern anime background, nuanced but simple cel-like shadow masses with a few soft transitions. A calm, comfortable palette with crisp focal edges; the large foreground dark chair and clear distant window establish depth without clutter. No global mist overlay.
